This page tracks onboarding for the three new engineers joining in July. Owner: Team Directory.

Goals

Pick from the good-first-issue label

Week one checklist

Laptop and accounts
Read the architecture overview
Clone the monorepo
Run the setup script
Shell
Copy
pnpm install pnpm dev
Ask questions early. Nobody expects you to know the codebase.
